messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable “3d fc 27” game for phone and tablet.

## Requirements
- Build the game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Support mobile devices and usable touch controls.
- Save screenshots as small JPEGs (viewport ≤1280px) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented an original penalty-shootout game with five shots, movement, drag aiming, chargeable shot power, keeper saves, score, and replay.
- Used Three.js from a CDN and a responsive HTML/CSS interface.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created a 3D football stadium, player, keeper, goal, ball, and mobile-responsive HUD/menu in `index.html`.
- Added touch and keyboard controls, charging/power, shot results, score tracking, and end-game/replay flow.
- Confirmed JavaScript syntax with `node --check`.
- Started local server and opened the page in Playwright; saved and inspected `/tmp/opencode/fc27.jpg`.

### Active
- Validate that the rendered game and controls work correctly in-browser.

### Blocked
- Browser showed a blank screenshot; likely caused by the overwritten `index.html` ending after scene setup without the game logic and closing script/body markup.
- A complete tail containing game logic exists at `/tmp/opencode/fc27-tail.html`, but it must be appended to `index.html`’s current Three.js scene content and the resulting document retested.

## Next Move
1. Append the contents of `/tmp/opencode/fc27-tail.html` after the current scene setup in `index.html`, ensuring there is exactly one closing `</script></body></html>`.
2. Run `node --check` on the extracted module script and reload `http://localhost:3002`.
3. Capture a fresh JPEG at viewport ≤1280px and inspect it; test starting and taking a shot if possible.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Current in-progress game document; presently ends after creating the Three.js scene and lacks gameplay logic/closing markup.
- `/tmp/opencode/fc27-tail.html`: Saved gameplay/UI logic and closing markup to append to `index.html`.
- `/tmp/opencode/fc27.jpg`: Latest screenshot, which appeared blank.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- `playwright-cli` is installed and the Chromium browser was installed; local server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- The initial Playwright console error was only a missing `/favicon.ico` (404).
